review: The car was great initially, but after a few months the engine started making a strange noise. Sometimes it doesn't start at all. Very disappointed.
Brakes suddenly stopped responding while driving. This is extremely dangerous.
AC stopped cooling properly after a few weeks and makes a weird sound.
Love the mileage and comfort, no issues so far!
Battery drains overnight even when parked. Had to jump start twice this month.
Engine makes a rattling noise on cold start, dealership says its normal but Im not convinced.
The infotainment screen freezes randomly and needs a restart.
Excellent service from the dealership, very happy with the purchase.
Brake pads wore out way too quickly, replaced at 8000 km already.
AC compressor stopped working completely, no cold air at all.
